metadata.question: Did the water extent in the northern part of Lake Eyre increase between June 20, 2025 and September 15, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Compare water extent for two windows around the dates:
   - Period 1: 2025-06-13 to 2025-06-27
   - Period 2: 2025-09-08 to 2025-09-22
   Geometry: A polygon covering the northern basin of Lake Eyre (Kati Thanda).
   Primary dataset: Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized (S2_SR_HARMONIZED). Fallbacks: Landsat 9 L2 SR, then Landsat 8 L2 SR. If all empty, widen ±15 days and retry.
2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds and shadows (not water) using S2 SCL classes (3,8,9,10,11). For Landsat, use QA_PIXEL bits (cloud, shadow, cirrus). Compute MNDWI (G-SWIR1)/(G+SWIR1); threshold > 0.2 for water.
3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null/Error: 
   - If collection size == 0 after fallback/widening: C1.
   - If valid pixels after masking == 0: C2.
   - If computed values are null/NaN/invalid: C3.
   - Otherwise compare water area; if Period 2 > Period 1, answer A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  const scale = 1000; // meters
  const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[136.7, -28.3], [137.95, -28.3], [137.95, -29.3], [136.7, -29.3], [136.7, -28.3]]],
    null, false
  );

  const period1 = {start: '2025-06-13', end: '2025-06-27'};
  const period2 = {start: '2025-09-08', end: '2025-09-22'};

  function widenRange(startStr, endStr, days) {
    const msPerDay = 24*60*60*1000;
    const s = new Date(startStr);
    const e = new Date(endStr);
    const ws = new Date(s.getTime() - days*msPerDay);
    const we = new Date(e.getTime() + days*msPerDay);
    const fmt = (d)=> d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
    return {start: fmt(ws), end: fmt(we)};
  }

  function getInfoAsync(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res);
      });
    });
  }

  function maskS2(img) {
    const scl = img.select('SCL');
    const mask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)).and(scl.neq(11));
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }

  function maskL2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0);
    const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0);
    const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 7).eq(0);
    // Scale optical SR bands
    const scaled = img.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'])
                      .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    return img.addBands(scaled, null, true).updateMask(cloud.and(shadow).and(cirrus));
  }

  async function buildPeriod(startStr, endStr) {
    // Try S2
    let source = 'S2';
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .filterDate(startStr, endStr);
    let n = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (n === 0) {
      // Try Landsat 9
      source = 'L9';
      col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .filterDate(startStr, endStr);
      n = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      if (n === 0) {
        // Try Landsat 8
        source = 'L8';
        col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
          .filterBounds(geom)
          .filterDate(startStr, endStr);
        n = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      }
      if (n === 0) {
        // Widen ±15 days and retry Sentinel-2
        const w = widenRange(startStr, endStr, 15);
        source = 'S2w';
        col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
          .filterBounds(geom)
          .filterDate(w.start, w.end);
        n = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
        if (n === 0) {
          return {status: 'C1', start: startStr, end: endStr, sourceTried: 'S2,L9,L8,S2w'};
        } else {
          startStr = w.start; endStr = w.end;
        }
      }
    }

    let meanCloudProp = null;
    let maskedCol = null;
    let composite = null;
    let mndwi = null;
    let water = null;

    if (source.startsWith('S2')) {
      meanCloudProp = await getInfoAsync(col.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE'));
      maskedCol = col.map(maskS2);
      composite = maskedCol.median().clip(geom);
      mndwi = composite.expression('(G - S)/(G + S)', {
        G: composite.select('B3'),
        S: composite.select('B11')
      }).rename('MNDWI');
    } else {
      meanCloudProp = await getInfoAsync(col.aggregate_mean('CLOUD_COVER'));
      maskedCol = col.map(maskL2);
      composite = maskedCol.median().clip(geom);
      // Prefer L9; if L8 used, same band names
      mndwi = composite.expression('(G - S)/(G + S)', {
        G: composite.select('SR_B3'),
        S: composite.select('SR_B6')
      }).rename('MNDWI');
    }

    // Valid pixels count
    const validCountDict = await getInfoAsync(
      mndwi.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      })
    );
    const validPx = validCountDict ? validCountDict['MNDWI'] : null;
    if (!validPx || validPx === 0) {
      return {status: 'C2', start: startStr, end: endStr, source, imgCount: n, meanCloudProp};
    }

    // Water mask and counts
    water = mndwi.gt(0.2).rename('water').updateMask(mndwi.mask());
    const waterSumDict = await getInfoAsync(
      water.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      })
    );
    const waterPx = waterSumDict ? waterSumDict['water'] : null;

    if (waterPx === null || waterPx === undefined || !isFinite(waterPx)) {
      return {status: 'C3', start: startStr, end: endStr, source, imgCount: n, meanCloudProp};
    }

    const waterAreaKm2 = (waterPx * scale * scale) / 1e6;

    return {
      status: 'OK',
      start: startStr,
      end: endStr,
      source,
      imgCount: n,
      meanCloudProp: meanCloudProp,
      validPx: validPx,
      waterPx: waterPx,
      waterAreaKm2: waterAreaKm2
    };
  }

  try {
    // Run both periods
    const p1 = await buildPeriod(period1.start, period1.end);
    const p2 = await buildPeriod(period2.start, period2.end);

    // Failure handling
    if (p1.status !== 'OK' || p2.status !== 'OK') {
      if (p1.status === 'C1' || p2.status === 'C1') {
        console.log('Empty Collection for at least one period.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      if (p1.status === 'C2' || p2.status === 'C2') {
        console.log('No valid pixels after masking for at least one period.');
        console.log('C2');
        return;
      }
      if (p1.status === 'C3' || p2.status === 'C3') {
        console.log('Calculation failure (null/NaN).');
        console.log('C3');
        return;
      }
      console.log('Unknown processing issue.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }

    // Evidence prints (<= 20 lines)
    console.log(`P1 Window: ${p1.start} to ${p1.end}`);
    console.log(`P1 Source: ${p1.source} | Images: ${p1.imgCount} | MeanCloud: ${p1.meanCloudProp !== null ? p1.meanCloudProp.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%`);
    console.log(`P1 Valid px: ${p1.validPx} | Water px: ${p1.waterPx} | Water area km2: ${p1.waterAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);

    console.log(`P2 Window: ${p2.start} to ${p2.end}`);
    console.log(`P2 Source: ${p2.source} | Images: ${p2.imgCount} | MeanCloud: ${p2.meanCloudProp !== null ? p2.meanCloudProp.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%`);
    console.log(`P2 Valid px: ${p2.validPx} | Water px: ${p2.waterPx} | Water area km2: ${p2.waterAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);

    const diff = p2.waterAreaKm2 - p1.waterAreaKm2;
    console.log(`Δ water km2 (P2 - P1): ${diff.toFixed(1)}`);

    // Final decision
    if (!isFinite(diff)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    // Minimal tolerance to avoid noise
    const increased = diff > 0.5;
    console.log(increased ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
